name: Possessed Dog
body:
POSSESSED DOG
CR 1

XP 400
CE Medium animal
Init +2; low-light vision, scent; Perception +8

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 12, flat-footed 11 (+2 Dex, +1 natural)
hp 12 (2d8 + 4)
Fort +5, Ref +5, Will +1

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee bite +3 (1d6+3 plus trip)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks trip

STATISTICS

Str 15, Dex 15, Con 15, Int 2, Wis 12, Cha 6
Base Atk +1; CMB +3; CMD 15 (19 vs. trip)
Feats Skill Focus (Perception)
Skills Acrobatics +6 (+14 jumping), Perception +8, Survival +1 (+5 scent tracking)
Languages —
SQ scent, low-light vision

ABOUT

A large guard hound warped by malevolent haunting, its eyes bloodshot and frothing ichor dripping from its jaws. Broken chains dangle from its rusted iron collar as it drags freshly slaughtered game into the woodland perimeter.

Possessed Dogs hunt with relentless savagery, shattering windowpanes and bursting through wooden doorways during nighttime thunderstorms to drag travelers to the floor and crush their windpipes.
